name: maglev-vehicle
$comment: A car section on two EMS modules.

plots.title: Body heave [m], vertical acceleration [m/s^2] and pitch rate [rad/s]
Guideway deflection under the two modules [m]

parameters.name: h_skid
parameters.description: Gap while the module rests on its skids (estimate)

parameters.name: h_stop
parameters.description: Touch-down stop: the pole face would hit the rail below this gap (estimate)

parameters.name: alpha
parameters.description: Magnet force constant: F = alpha*i^2/h^2 (= mu0 N^2 A_pole/4)

parameters.name: L_inf
parameters.description: Coil leakage inductance; L(h) = L_inf + 2 alpha/h

parameters.name: h_rest
parameters.description: Gap at rest: the skids carry the weight on the contact stiffness

parameters.name: c_trim
parameters.description: Trim law i = c_trim*h that carries the weight at any gap

parameters.name: e_spring
parameters.description: Static stretch of the secondary spring under the body weight

parameters.name: Tf
parameters.description: Derivative filter of the gap controller

parameters.name: m_c
parameters.description: Body mass carried by one module (half the car body)

parameters.name: J_roll
parameters.description: Roll inertia of the car body (homogeneous box)

parameters.name: J_pitch
parameters.description: Pitch inertia of the car body

parameters.name: J_yaw
parameters.description: Yaw inertia of the car body

parameters.name: x_m
parameters.description: Module position from the centre of mass (front +, rear -)

parameters.name: q_end
parameters.description: Distance of the move: accelerate, cruise for T_cruise, brake

parameters.name: tau_lsm
parameters.description: Thrust response of the long stator

parameters.name: t_ref
parameters.description: Time the gap reference steps to the nominal gap

options.text: A 53 t car section on two EMS modules: lift-off at 0.1 s, then the long stator accelerates it to 430 km/h, it cruises and brakes. The guideway sags between its pillars and has one 2 mm bump at 8.5 km. The 3D view exaggerates gap, heave and pitch 100 times.
